purpose: Implement the missing actual fusion-feature/quality-to-track-memory contract. Descriptor-only identity query models are not substituted for this direction.
formal_eligibility: Only after the original current-November-IR visual primary passes complete Dev versus direct/fresh RGB and same-mode RGB/gray; freeze the visual primary, then register a complete F4 Dev/Test/cost workflow. No current learned visual feature is transferred during this engineering-only stage.

memory.input: Independently ROI-aligned actual RGB P3, learned native auxiliary P3 and fused P3 from the same current frame; fused/RGB channels match. Never replace fused features with an unrelated crop encoder.
memory.reliability: r=det_score*(1-max_current_detection_box_IoU)*q. IoU is an occlusion proxy and q is the provided fusion-weight reliability proxy, not calibrated ground truth uncertainty.
memory.acceptance: score>0.6 and r>=0.2 and a finite nonzero embedding; otherwise freeze that memory
memory.mixing: L2-normalize((1-0.2*r)*old+0.2*r*current); initialize directly on the first accepted observation
memory.age: Actual current frame minus last reliable update, independently per stream; effective stored reliability decays exp(-age/25)
memory.unavailable: No auxiliary/fused array access if unavailable. Freeze auxiliary/fused memory and use RGB memory for current association. Whole-sequence unavailable route must match the same RGB-memory control.
quality_controls: provided same q for all three memories on an available observation
uniform q=1 ablation and strong ordinary RGB-memory control

association.backend: Original BYTETracker via its existing track_factory/association_hook; baseline file bytes unchanged
association.stages: Only primary high-score association; secondary and pending costs unchanged
association.cost: Add nonnegative appearance_weight*past_effective_reliability*current_reliability*(1-cosine)/2 to existing cost on already valid edges with predicted-box IoU>=0.1. Never decrease costs or open an original over-threshold edge.
association.zero: weight0 does not read or update feature memory and must exactly match BYTETracker boxes, scores, IDs and all tracked/lost/removed states under identical per-sequence ID initialization
association.sequence: Explicit sequence and consecutive frame arguments; clear all state at a new video beginning at frame1; no retrospective relabeling

ROI.coordinates: Accept original-image boxes; explicitly multiply by the actual resize ratio, clip to resized valid image rectangle and derive equal X/Y stride from actual input/P3 sizes. Reject inconsistent geometry.
ROI.engineering_geometry_check: Known network-coordinate linear planes, ROI[8,4,40,20] at stride8 must average to[24,12]; CPU was checked before this protocol was written

required_formal_controls: ByteTrack on the same selected visual detections
RGB-memory versus fused-memory on identical visual detections and q, equal three-weight Dev choice budgets
Strong ordinary RGB-memory q=1 and fused-memory q=1
Missing and wrong actual IR through both visual and memory paths
Freeze/quality removal and original strong RGB/gray visual controls
All engineering-passed trained formal candidates full7Test15985, even when Dev negative; all47fields/per-sequence/originalCSV/cost
current_CPU_scope: Synthetic embeddings/ROI planes and full4834-frame cached RGB Dev detection replay of the weight0 path only. No learned fusion features, new image encoding, Test replay, accuracy evaluation, saved model or formal F4 fit.

execution.release: Any future F4 CUDA work waits for all currently registered queues including the conditional factorial extension and their actual process exits

novelty: Normalized appearance memory, EMA and score weighting have established prior art. Only controlled evidence for actual learned fusion features/quality could support a fusion contribution; ordinary RGB memory gain must be reported separately.
